QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: integrationEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Enable PixEagle
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Connect to a PixEagle companion for each vehicle. Saved sign-in uses this device's system password store when selected.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: videoEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Show PixEagle video in Fly View
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Show PixEagle video in Fly View
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Show the selected PixEagle companion's authenticated video. Turn off to use QGC's configured camera source.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: tapToTarget
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Tap video to select targets
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Select or replace a target directly in the video. When disabled, use Select target or Retarget before each selection.
